feedback:
Approved because one action run remains and no revision could be reviewed and then raced within this iteration. The candidate changes only geometry.sensor_positions, widening the array from x = ±0.024 m to x = -0.03, -0.015, 0, 0.015, 0.03 m. Everything else matches the iteration 4 best (score 554.98): base_speed 1.1, kp 3.0, kd 0.8, ki 0, sensor_weights [-2,-1,0,1,2], sensor_size 0.012, line_loss 'last_direction', and body and wheel geometry.

The earlier evidence supports testing this. In iteration 4 the slalom still finished 0 of 20 with max_error 0.0613 and one line-loss event per run, and rms_error stayed low (0.017), so the failures are edge excursions rather than poor average tracking. Iteration 3 to 4 showed that speed alone did not clear the slalom, so geometry is the next untested lever. The s-bend (9 of 20 finished, max_error 0.053) and oval (20 of 20 finished, max_error 0.014) are the tracks to protect. Whether the wider spread helps is not known until it races.

What to do with the telemetry in the next iteration. If the slalom max_error is still at or above 0.06, or slalom line_loss_events stay near 1, try controller.kd 0.9 with the wider spread kept, since steering_oscillation is already 0.37 on the s-bend. If the oval or s-bend completion drops or steering_oscillation rises well above 0.37, revert to the iteration 4 spread (±0.024 m) and keep base_speed at 1.1, because the wider signal may be noisier on straights.
requested_changes: If slalom max_error is still at or above 0.06 with the wider spread (x = ±0.03 m) at base_speed 1.1, set controller.kd to 0.9 and keep the wider geometry.sensor_positions, since iteration 4 slalom max_error was 0.0613 and s-bend steering_oscillation was 0.37 at kd 0.8.

If steering_oscillation rises clearly above 0.37 on the s-bend or oval completion falls below the iteration 4 level (20 of 20), revert geometry.sensor_positions to x = -0.024, -0.012, 0, 0.012, 0.024 m (the iteration 4 spread) and keep base_speed at 1.1.

If slalom line_loss_events fall toward 0.5 or less but the slalom still ends off track, keep the wider spread and hold base_speed at 1.1 rather than lowering it, since iteration 3 to 4 showed the s-bend mean finish time of 2.56 s is close to the 3 s limit.
